reviews.title: Good price for name brand aio
reviews.comment: Its a big radiator, longer then some competitors so make sure your case has a decent top mount length.  My case ended up being too short on top so had to do a reverse flow, mounting radiator to front exhausting out to front and balancing with two down in blowing fans on top and one in fan at the top back of case.  Power supply blows whatever heat out to bottom of the case so overall temps been good.  Avg temps at cpu 49-51c on an amd  9950x3d after running a few 3dmark benchmarks.  Rgb on pump is ok, overall its quiet and seems to be doing a good job.
reviews.author: Maleko

reviews.title: Great budget AIO!
reviews.comment: Despite the complete lack of online reviews for this product, it's a solid AIO. I decided to give it a shot purely for the design, and it doesn't disappoint. It's quiet, cheap, and looks great! The installation has some tricks to learn to make it easier (put the clips on first and tighten the screw a bit and then install on the CPU), but I'm not sure if that's just an AM5 thing. It's exactly the product I was looking for; an interesting AIO to tie my new build together. Would heavily recommend!
reviews.author: Colby

reviews.title: Great money can buy!
reviews.comment: I recently installed the Antec Skeleton 360 ARGB Liquid CPU Cooler and I’m very happy with it. Installation was simple and the cooling performance has been excellent so far. My CPU temperatures are much lower during gaming and heavy use, and it runs pretty quiet. The ARGB lighting looks great inside my case and gives the build a clean, premium look. Overall, it’s a solid 360mm cooler for the price and I definitely recommend it. I put some photos later
